mechanics.claim: The initial cast is a separate activation event from the recast/detonation, relevant to on-cast triggers.
mechanics.quote: The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Deactivating the ability manually (recast) does not count as an ability activation for on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: Deactivating the ability manually does not.

mechanics.claim: Damage and slow scale up continuously from minimum to maximum over the first 2 seconds after landing, capping at 150% of initial values.
mechanics.quote: increase its {{ccs|damage|magic}} and the effectiveness of its {{tip|slow}}, up to a maximum of 150% of their initial values
